We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied template 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (three outcomes). Need to choose one that can be further processed with next template 1914389, then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We need to construct a tree: root molecule, reaction using template 29646 -> children (precursor molecules). Then each precursor may undergo next reaction etc. The route must have at least 5 reactions (so chain of 5 steps). Use templates in that order.

We need to find a linear sequence: target -> after 29646 -> after 1914389 -> after 1914390 -> after 149040 -> after 1914391 -> final precursors (starting materials). So each step must be applicable.

We have applied 29646 and got three possible outcomes. Let's examine them:

Result from 29646: 
1) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C'
2) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO'
3) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO'

These are three possible disconnections. Need to pick one that works with template 1914389.

We applied 1914389 to the first one (with silyl ether on side chain) and got two products: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' and 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'. So template 1914389 splits the molecule into two fragments: a core cyclic part with silyl ether and a side chain ester? Actually second product is a separate molecule.

Thus after 1914389 we have two precursors. The route can be branched; but we need to continue applying next templates to each appropriate precursor? The order is fixed, but maybe each reaction step applies to each precursor individually? Typically retrosynthesis tree: each reaction node has children precursors. So after first reaction (29646) we have three precursors; we need to choose one branch and continue.

We need to apply 1914389 to that precursor, giving two precursors. Then apply 1914390 to each? The template 1914390 we tried on the cyclic silyl ether precursor and got no result. Also tried on the side chain ester and got no result. So maybe need different branch.

Let's try applying 1914389 to the second outcome from 29646: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO' (silyl on acid).
